zh.title: 維珍澳洲航空班機爆乘客滋擾 宣稱帶槍並攻擊空服員遭制服
zh.summary: 維珍澳洲航空航班爆乘客滋擾；宣稱帶槍並攻擊空服員；降落後遭制服
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，維珍澳洲航空（Virgin Australia）在一趟長達14小時的跨洲航班中發生乘客滋擾事件。機上兩名男性乘客在飛行途中宣稱持有槍枝，導致機組人員在大部分航程中均保持高度警戒狀態。
在飛行過程中，該兩名男性乘客對機上空服員發動攻擊，相關行為包括以頭撞擊空服員以及向空服員吐口水。機組人員在長達14小時的航程中持續進行安全應變與嚴密監控。
班機順利完成降落之後，這兩名宣稱帶槍並攻擊空服員的男子隨即遭到制服與拘束。 Simple Flying 指出，全體機組人員在整起事件中均維持高度警覺。

en.title: Virgin Australia Passengers Restrained After Claiming Gun and Assaulting Crew
en.summary: Virgin Australia flight crew on alert after passengers claim gun; two men restrained upon landing after assault.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, cabin crew members aboard a Virgin Australia flight were placed on high alert for most of a 14-hour long-haul journey. The security situation developed after two male passengers claimed to be in possession of a gun during the flight.
While in transit, the two men engaged in aggressive physical behavior directed at cabin crew personnel, which involved headbutting and spitting on flight attendants.
The flight crew maintained heightened security vigilance across the multi-hour trip until the aircraft landed, at which point both male passengers were restrained upon landing.

zh.title: 荷蘭簽署意向書擬採購薩博GlobalEye預警機
zh.summary: 荷蘭簽署意向書；計畫採購薩博GlobalEye預警機；預計2031年交機
body: 瑞典國防與航空製造商薩博（Saab）於2026年9月10日宣布，荷蘭已簽署意向書（Letter of Intent），計畫為其空軍採購GlobalEye空中預警與管制（AEW&C）飛機。這項意向書象徵荷蘭建立本國專屬預警機隊的最新進展，相關機型採用加拿大龐巴迪（Bombardier）Global 6000/6500商務客機平台改裝。
根據公布的內容，荷蘭目前計畫購買一架本國專屬的GlobalEye預警機。瑞典政府表示，該架飛機預計於2031年完成交付。此外，自2028年起，荷蘭空軍組員將能夠進入瑞典空軍，預先進行GlobalEye預警機的相關操作培訓，以利未來機隊順利接收與服役。
薩博總裁兼執行長米凱爾·約翰松（Micael Johansson）對荷蘭的採購意向表示歡迎，並指出該機型將能提升荷蘭軍方在多個領域的情勢感知與早期預警能力。薩博同時說明，目前雙方尚未簽署最終合約，薩博也尚未收到來自荷蘭的正式訂單，相關商業條款與細節仍待進一步落實。
在此之前，荷蘭並未擁有獨立的空中預警與管制能力，長期仰賴北約（NATO）共用的老舊E-3哨兵（Sentry）預警機隊。2026年7月，北約秘書長馬克·呂特（Mark Rutte）曾宣布包括荷蘭在內的11個歐洲北約盟國將共同採購最多10架GlobalEye預警機，以替換現有的E-3機隊。這次簽署的意向書則著重於荷蘭自行採購的單架本國機體。
隨著歐洲現有空中預警機隊面臨老舊淘汰，加上國防需求調整，以龐巴迪客機為基礎改裝的GlobalEye預警機獲得多國關注。歐洲盟國在選擇預警系統時考量多重因素，而薩博的GlobalEye與波音（Boeing）E-7 Wedgetail等機型均為市場關注焦點，薩博該款系統逐漸成為替換現役老舊預警機隊的重要選項之一。

en.title: Netherlands Signs Intent to Procure Saab GlobalEye Early Warning Aircraft
en.summary: Netherlands signs letter of intent for Saab GlobalEye airborne early warning aircraft delivery planned for 2031.
body: Swedish defense and aerospace manufacturer Saab announced on September 10, 2026, that the Netherlands has signed a Letter of Intent to purchase its GlobalEye Airborne Early Warning and Control (AEW&C) aircraft. The announcement marks the latest step in the Netherlands' plan to establish a sovereign early warning capability for its air force, utilizing the GlobalEye system based on the Bombardier Global business jet platform.

Under the current arrangement, the Netherlands plans to acquire a single sovereign aircraft dedicated to its own air force. According to the Swedish government, delivery of the Dutch aircraft is targeted for 2031. Additionally, beginning in 2028, Dutch crews will have the opportunity to train on GlobalEye aircraft within the Swedish Air Force to prepare for future operational deployment.

Micael Johansson, President and CEO of Saab, welcomed the notification of intent, stating that the aircraft will enhance the situational awareness and early warning capabilities of Dutch forces across multiple domains. However, Saab clarified that the parties have not yet signed a final contract, and the manufacturer has not yet received an official order from the Netherlands.

Currently, the Netherlands lacks a sovereign airborne early warning capability and relies on NATO's shared fleet of aging E-3 Sentry radar aircraft. In July 2026, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte announced that 11 European NATO allies, including the Netherlands, will jointly procure up to ten GlobalEye aircraft to replace the alliance's E-3 Sentries. The new Letter of Intent represents an additional procurement effort focused on a sovereign Dutch aircraft.

The demand for airborne early warning replacement has grown as existing regional fleets face aging infrastructure and operational limitations. While Boeing's E-7 Wedgetail serves in other international forces, European nations have increasingly examined European-built solutions such as the Saab GlobalEye to fulfill future defense requirements and maintain long-term surveillance capabilities.

zh.title: 全球航空公司附加收入成長13.4% 聯合航空與Frontier表現亮眼
zh.summary: 全球航空公司附加收入成長13.4%；聯合航空以115億美元居冠
body: 根據 IdeaWorksCompany 最新發布的附加收入年鑑數據顯示，全球 58 家具備可比數據的航空公司在 2024 年與 2025 年期間，附加收入（Ancillary Revenue）顯著成長 13.4%，單年增加了 132 億美元。相較之下，這些航空公司的整體總營收僅成長 7.2%。統計指出，目前全球已有 30 家航空公司每年可透過附加產品與服務創造超過 10 億美元的營收，高於前一年的 27 家。

在附加收入占總營收比例方面，超低成本航空表現最為突出。Frontier Airlines 在 2025 年以 60.2% 的附加收入占比高居全球榜首，顯示該公司的附加收入已超過其核心機票營收。此外，Spirit Airlines 以 59.8% 緊追在後，Allegiant 為 59.6%，而 Volaris 與 Breeze Airways 各自占總營收的 55.4%。前十名完全由低成本航空公司包辦，反映出業者普遍鼓勵旅客單獨購買托運行李及其他加值服務的策略。

大型傳統網路航空公司則展現了不同的附加收入結構。聯合航空（United Airlines）在 2025 年創造了高達 115 億美元的附加收入，年增率為 9.3%，成為受調查航空公司中附加收入金額最高的業者。達美航空（Delta Air Lines）與美國航空（American Airlines）則分別以約 108 億美元與 97 億美元緊隨其後。四大美國航空公司（美國航空、達美航空、西南航空與聯合航空）在 2025 年僅憑常客計畫就獲得 279 億美元收入，平均每位旅客貢獻 37.72 美元。
在單客附加收入方面，英國休閒航空公司 Jet2.com 以每位乘客 100.73 美元的表現創下該年鑑 19 年歷史上的最高紀錄。IdeaWorksCompany 指出，選位費與品牌票價（Branded Fares）是推動近年附加收入強勁成長的核心動力，許多旅客雖被低廉的基礎票價吸引，後續仍會加價購買托運行李、加大手提行李、優先登機或選位等各項服務。

en.title: Global Airline Ancillary Revenue Up 13.4% as United and Frontier Lead Key Metrics
en.summary: IdeaWorksCompany reports airline ancillary revenue grew 13.4 percent, with United Airlines generating 11.5 billion dollars.
body: According to the latest IdeaWorksCompany Yearbook of Ancillary Revenue, ancillary revenue for 58 tracked airlines grew by 13.4 percent between 2024 and 2025, adding $13.2 billion in a single year. This growth rate substantially outpaced the 7.2 percent gain in overall airline revenue during the same period. The data highlights that 30 airlines now generate at least $1 billion annually from ancillary products and services, compared with 27 carriers in the previous year's evaluation.

Ultra-low-cost carriers dominated the rankings when ancillary revenue was measured as a proportion of total company earnings. Frontier Airlines captured the top position for 2025, generating 60.2 percent of its revenue from ancillary items, meaning non-ticket sources generated more income than basic fare sales. Other low-cost carriers followed closely, including Spirit Airlines at 59.8 percent, Allegiant at 59.6 percent, and both Volaris and Breeze Airways at 55.4 percent, as low-cost business models increasingly encourage unbundled travel services.

For large full-service network airlines in the United States, frequent-flyer programs and co-branded credit card relationships served as major growth drivers. United Airlines generated $11.5 billion in ancillary revenue in 2025, representing a 9.3 percent increase from the previous year and the highest total amount among all carriers analyzed. Delta Air Lines generated approximately $10.8 billion, while American Airlines achieved $9.7 billion. Collectively, American, Delta, Southwest, and United generated $27.9 billion from frequent-flyer programs in 2025, averaging $37.72 per passenger.

In per-passenger performance, British leisure carrier Jet2.com set a historic benchmark by generating $100.73 per passenger in ancillary revenue, representing the highest figure recorded in the 19-year history of the Yearbook. Industry analysis indicates that seat selection fees and bundled branded fares have become primary drivers of this revenue growth, allowing airlines to monetize additional passenger choices after initial flight bookings.

zh.title: Sceye高空平臺完成3萬公里美日往返飛行驗證直接通訊
zh.summary: Sceye高空平臺完成美日往返飛行；於日本上空測試手機與無人機通訊
body: 高空通訊平臺開發商Sceye宣佈，旗下「服務測試1號」（ST1）高空平臺系統（HAPS）已完成往返美國新墨西哥州與日本之間近3萬公里的飛行任務。該無人平臺在橫跨太平洋的任務期間，於日本上空成功驗證了直接連線至行動裝置（direct-to-device）的通訊能力、無人機對空通訊，以及機載資料處理等關鍵技術。
根據飛行紀錄，ST1任務於8月9日自美國新墨西哥州起飛，歷經13天飛行後進入日本管轄空域。平臺在日本空域停留超過一週時間後展開返航，於9月4日重新進入美國本土空域，並於9月5日抵達位於新墨西哥州莫里亞蒂的Sceye總部附近空域。在執行預定的降落與回收程序之前，該公司針對載具進行了進一步的性能測試。
ST1為一款採用輕於空氣設計的無人平臺，日間利用太陽能供電，夜間則依靠電池維持運作。本次任務中，平臺於平流層約16.5公里至17公里的高度運行。平臺搭載名為SceyeCELL的機載電信系統，並與日本電信業者軟銀（SoftBank）合作，成功以未經修改的市售智慧型手機完成寬頻連線，測試項目包括簡訊發送、語音通話、網際網路存取、影片串流以及大規模災害警報系統。
除了地面手機連線外，Sceye與軟銀亦在日本海岸附近的目標區域內，完成高空平臺與無人機之間的通訊測試，期間平臺展現出最低僅5公里的定點停留半徑（station-seeking radius）。軟銀於2025年投資Sceye的HAPS計畫，旨在建構結合地面基地台、高空平臺與衛星星座的三維通訊網路。

en.title: Sceye Completes 30,000 km US-Japan HAPS Flight Testing Direct Device Connectivity
en.summary: Sceye completed a 30,000 km round-trip flight between New Mexico and Japan using its ST1 high-altitude platform.
body: High-altitude platform developer Sceye has completed a nearly 30,000 km round-trip flight mission between New Mexico in the United States and Japan using its Service Test 1 (ST1) platform. During the flight across the Pacific Ocean, the high-altitude platform system (HAPS) demonstrated direct-to-device mobile connectivity, communications with drones, and onboard data processing capabilities over Japan.

The ST1 mission originally departed from New Mexico on August 9, arriving in Japanese-managed airspace 13 days later. The platform remained over Japan for more than a week before commencing its return trip across the Pacific. It re-entered continental United States airspace on September 4 and reached airspace near Sceye's headquarters in Moriarty, New Mexico, on September 5. The company conducted further vehicle tests before executing a planned termination and descent.

During the mission, Sceye's unmanned lighter-than-air platform operated in the stratosphere at altitudes between approximately 16.5 km and 17 km. The aircraft utilizes solar power during daylight hours and battery storage at night. In collaboration with telecommunications company SoftBank, ST1 carried the SceyeCELL airborne telecommunications payload to demonstrate direct mobile broadband connection to unmodified commercial smartphones. The flight tests encompassed text messaging, voice calls, internet access, video streaming, and disaster alert messaging systems.

In addition to direct smartphone connections, Sceye and SoftBank tested communications between the stratospheric platform and airborne drones off the coast of Japan. During operations in its target zone, ST1 achieved a station-seeking radius as low as 5 km. SoftBank, which previously invested in Sceye's HAPS program in 2025, stated that the test flight increases confidence in developing non-terrestrial three-dimensional networks that integrate ground infrastructure, stratospheric platforms, and satellite constellations.

zh.title: 波蘭MSPO國防展聚焦無人系統 安杜里爾展示Fury與Thunder
zh.summary: 波蘭MSPO展示多款無人機；安杜里爾推廣Fury與Thunder無人機
body: 波蘭第34屆國際國防工業展（MSPO 2026）於2026年9月8日至11日在凱爾采（Kielce）登場。本屆展覽聚焦於無人航空器、反無人機技術，以及自主平台與傳統戰鬥航空器搭配運作的新方案。展會吸引來自43個國家的參展商參與，展覽空間全數額滿。
在無人機領域，波蘭在地企業展示了多款新型無人系統。波蘭WB集團展出GLADIUS 2噴射動力無人打擊機，旨在將該公司的GLADIUS系列擴展至更遠航程的任務。此外，波蘭FlyFocus公司推出重達15公斤的TASACK電動巡飛彈，Ala.com公司則展示Husaria A3無人機載台，可搭載小型的Pika A1攔截無人機。
美國國防科技公司安杜里爾（Anduril）於展會期間，向波蘭推廣兩款設計與有人戰鬥平台配合運作的大型自主航空器。安杜里爾推廣其Fury協同戰鬥航空器，搭配波蘭已訂購的32架F-35A戰鬥機運作，作為忠誠伴飛機；同時也向波蘭官員介紹Thunder自主旋翼機，提案作為波蘭96架AH-64E阿帕契攻擊直升機的無人夥伴，該批直升機預計於2028年開始交付。
在相關供應鏈與支援合作方面，波蘭先前已就其阿帕契直升機機隊建立工業合作機制。根據本站歷史紀錄，WZL-1、WCKBT與波音公司已於2026年8月11日在波蘭羅茲簽署後勤抵銷協議，為波蘭AH-64E阿帕契直升機機隊的維修與地面支援建立長期合作關係。

en.title: Poland's MSPO 2026 highlights drones as Anduril pitches Fury and Thunder
en.summary: Anduril pitched autonomous aircraft at MSPO 2026; Polish firms unveiled new unmanned strike systems.
body: Poland's 34th International Defence Industry Exhibition (MSPO 2026) opened in Kielce, running from September 8 to 11. The exhibition features a strong focus on unmanned aircraft, counter-drone technologies, and new concepts for pairing autonomous platforms with conventional crewed combat aircraft. Organizers stated that exhibitors from 43 countries are participating in the event, with all available exhibition space fully booked.

Unmanned systems took center stage in the aerospace section of the show, with several Polish manufacturers unveiling new aerial platforms. Poland's WB Group showcased the GLADIUS 2, a new jet-powered unmanned strike aircraft designed to extend the company's GLADIUS family into longer-range operational missions. Additionally, Polish firm FlyFocus introduced TASACK, a 15-kilogram electrically powered loitering munition, while Ala.com presented the Husaria A3 reusable drone carrier configured to transport smaller Pika A1 interceptor drones into operational zones.

American defence technology firm Anduril utilized MSPO 2026 to pitch two larger autonomous aircraft intended to pair with Poland's incoming crewed combat fleets. Anduril proposed its Fury collaborative combat aircraft as a loyal wingman to operate alongside Poland's 32 ordered F-35A fighter jets. The company also held discussions with Polish officials regarding its Thunder autonomous rotorcraft, proposing it as an unmanned pairing partner for Poland's 96 ordered AH-64E Apache attack helicopters, which are scheduled to begin deliveries in 2028.

These developments build upon existing industrial support structures established for Poland's helicopter fleet. According to SKYTICAL historical records, WZL-1, WCKBT, and Boeing signed offset implementation agreements in Łódź, Poland, on August 11, 2026, to establish long-term industrial cooperation covering maintenance, sustainment, and ground support services for Poland's incoming AH-64E Apache fleet.

facts.sourceQuote: Poland’s WB Group is showing GLADIUS 2, a new jet-powered unmanned strike aircraft intended to extend the company’s existing GLADIUS family into longer-range missions.

facts.claim: FlyFocus unveiled the TASACK loitering munition, while Ala.com presented the Husaria A3 drone carrier carrying Pika A1 interceptors.
facts.sourceQuote: FlyFocus , used MSPO to unveil TASACK, a 15 kg electrically powered loitering munition

facts.claim: Anduril offered its Fury autonomous aircraft to operate alongside Poland's 32 ordered F-35As as a loyal wingman.
facts.sourceQuote: company is pitching its Fury collaborative combat aircraft to operate alongside Poland’s F-35s . Warsaw has ordered 32 F-35As.

facts.claim: Anduril proposed its Thunder autonomous rotorcraft to accompany Poland's 96 ordered AH-64E Apache helicopters, with deliveries scheduled to begin in 2028.
facts.sourceQuote: Thunder, unveiled at the Farnborough International Airshow in July, is being proposed as an unmanned partner for the AH-64E Apache. Poland has ordered 96 Apaches, with deliveries due to begin in 2028.

facts.claim: On August 11, 2026, WZL-1, WCKBT, and Boeing signed offset agreements in Poland to establish industrial cooperation for supporting Poland's AH-64E Apache fleet.
facts.sourceQuote: Wojskowe Zakłady Lotnicze Nr 1 S.A. (WZL-1), the Military Central Bureau of Design and Technology S.A. (WCKBT) and Boeing have signed offset implementation agreements to establish long-term industrial cooperation supporting the sustainment, maintenance and ground support of Poland’s AH-64E Apache helicopter fleet.
